drafter.message_to_opposing_counsel: Our client proposes a settlement payment of USD 40,000,000, payable within ten business days after execution by all parties. The proposed release is limited to the claims actually asserted by Harrow against Delmar in the operative complaint in the action being settled and becomes effective only upon receipt of the full payment in cleared funds. Enforcement rights and claims outside that scope remain reserved. Please confirm the case caption, court, docket number, and operative complaint date so we can complete the identification of the released claims before signature. We have also included the requested confidentiality exceptions for legal and tax advisers, legally required disclosures, and enforcement. These terms remain subject to execution of a definitive agreement.

edits.text: RECITALS. Plaintiff Harrow and Defendant Delmar wish to resolve only the claims actually asserted by Harrow against Delmar in the operative complaint dated [date] in [full case caption, court, and docket number] (the “Action” and the “Settled Claims,” respectively). The identifying information in this recital must be completed and agreed before execution.

1. PAYMENT. Defendant shall pay Plaintiff USD 40,000,000 (the “Settlement Amount”) by wire transfer of immediately available funds to an account designated in writing by Plaintiff, no later than ten business days after the date on which all parties have executed this Agreement. Plaintiff shall provide wire instructions promptly following execution. For this purpose, a business day is a day other than a Saturday, Sunday, or U.S. federal banking holiday. Time is of the essence with respect to payment.

2. RELEASE. Only upon Plaintiff’s receipt of the full Settlement Amount in cleared, immediately available funds shall Plaintiff release Defendant from the Settled Claims. No other claims, persons, or entities are released. Until full payment is received, no release is effective and Plaintiff retains its rights with respect to the Settled Claims. Nothing in this Agreement releases or impairs any right to enforce this Agreement. Any amounts received shall be credited against any recovery on the Settled Claims to prevent double recovery.

3. CONFIDENTIALITY. The parties shall keep the terms of this settlement confidential, except that either party may disclose them to its legal and tax advisers who are subject to professional or contractual confidentiality obligations, as required by applicable law or legal process, or as reasonably necessary to enforce this Agreement. Disclosures shall be limited to what is reasonably necessary for the permitted purpose. To the extent legally permitted and practicable, a party compelled to disclose shall provide the other party advance notice and a reasonable opportunity to seek confidential treatment.
